info.name: CL RP.Inside Auth Example
info.description:
# RP Inside Authentication

This collection demonstrates OAuth Authorization and Application Silent login as documented on [https://developer.corelogic.asia/apis/guides/application-silent-login-au-nz](https://developer.corelogic.asia/apis/guides/application-silent-login-au-nz)

### Get Started

Set the credentials in the Pre-request Script of this collection.

> You may need to configure Postman Cookies "Domains Allowlist" to add the authentication domains:

- UAT access-uat-api.corelogic.asia
- Production access-api.corelogic.asia
